Wrong:  Eventstream config includes the connection string
        directly, in plain text

Right:  Eventstream config references a Key Vault secret by
        name; the real value lives only in Key Vault
caption: Anything committed to Git is effectively permanent.

eyebrow: Managed identities -- no secret to manage
code:
With a secret:            something stored to leak, rotate, protect
With a managed identity:   nothing stored, nothing to leak,
                           nothing to rotate -- Fabric authenticates as itself
caption: The stronger option wherever the target resource supports it.
